# EPOCH

> EPOCH is Tasmania's integrated evidence-based clinical resource platform providing access to medical databases, guidelines, medicines information, and specialty-specific resources for healthcare professionals.

EPOCH serves the Tasmanian Health Service by centralizing access to clinical decision-support tools, evidence-based databases, and professional development resources. The platform integrates key medical references including UpToDate, DynaMed, MIMS, Therapeutic Guidelines, and Cochrane evidence to support clinical practice across all specialties.

## Key Topics

- Evidence-based practice
- Clinical databases
- Medicines information
- Therapeutic Guidelines
- UpToDate
- DynaMed
- MIMS Online
- Cochrane
- Clinical guidelines
- Specialty guides
- Medical reference tools
- Research databases
- Mobile apps
- Australian Medicines Handbook
- TRIP Database

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/home): EPOCH home page with access to clinical databases, guidelines, and medical resources
- [Apps & Tools](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/apps-tools): Directory of clinical apps and tools including DynaMed, MIMS, and UpToDate
- [Databases](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/databases): Directory of evidence-based clinical databases including Cochrane and systematic reviews
- [Specialty Guides](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/specialties): Specialty guides directory for clinical resources across medical specialties
- [Mobile Apps](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/mobile-apps): Directory of mobile apps for evidence-based practice, clinical guidelines, and medicines info

## Learning & Support

- [FAQs](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/faqs): FAQs covering EPOCH registration, OpenAthens access, login, and account setup
- [Training & Help](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/training): Training resources and help guides for EPOCH platform and evidence-based practice
- [Guides & Tutorials](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/guides-tutorials): User guides and tutorials for EPOCH tools, standards access, and research platforms
- [BrowZine Email Notifications](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/latest-journal-alerts): Guide to setting up BrowZine email alerts for journal notifications and current awareness

## Community & Submissions

- [Recommend a Resource](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/recommend-resource-form): Staff submission form to recommend resources for EPOCH Specialty Guides
- [Item Request](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/item-request-form): Form for requesting articles, books, and library items from Ramsay and Buttfield Libraries
- [EPOCH Latest News](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/news): News and updates on EPOCH, NSQHS standards, and healthcare evidence

## Optional

- [Events Calendar](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/calendar): Events calendar for EPOCH and Tasmania Health service scheduling
- [RSS Items](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/rss-items): RSS feed of research publications, clinical case studies, and peer-reviewed articles
- [Don't Rush to Crush Update](https://epoch.health.tas.gov.au/dont-rush-crush): Update on Don't Rush to Crush migration to Therapeutic Guidelines from March 2026
